g.text: How much does error vary across cities?

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526171

g.text: Same 10% calibration for every method. Scores frozen; city mappings fitted from scratch.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263f53

g.text: City SD measures differences between cities; it is not uncertainty around the average.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607181

g.text: Dots average the within-replication SD of 20 city MSEs over five replications. These are not standard errors.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607181

g.text: 28 paired calibration tracts + 252 test tracts per city. All methods use stable acquisition pairs. W targets are noise-free conditional means.
